other_conditions: Unit must be a new or existing entity with operations in Goa
Applicant unit must be one of: Proprietorship Firm, Private Limited Company, Public Limited Company, Registered Partnership Firm, or Limited Liability Partnership
Bank accounts of the unit and/or its partners/directors must be linked to Aadhaar
Bank accounts of Freshers must be linked to Aadhaar
Freshers must be employed for a minimum period of one year
Individuals who have worked more than two years before pursuing post‑graduation are not considered freshers
For individuals with less than two years of experience before post‑graduation, the fresher period is calculated on a prorated basis
benefits_summary: Matching grant up to ₹10,000 per fresher per month (₹12,500 for female freshers) for two continuous years of operation.
